name: knap-template
description: Local, source-first Markdown publishing with Knap templates and Pandoc

scripts.check: knap validate templates/frontmatter.kmd && knap validate templates/reference-index.kmd
scripts.html: npm run render && pandoc build/report.md --citeproc --standalone --mathml -o build/report.html
scripts.pdf: npm run html && "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=build/report.pdf build/report.html
